description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את מטרות השימוש המותרות ברכב במסגרת פוליסת ביטוח רכב. הפוליסה מכסה מטרות חברתיות, פרטיות או עסקיות שאינן מפורטות בסעיפים 6.1.2 עד 6.1.4. שימוש עסקי בהעברת נוסעים בתשלום או גרירת רכב בתשלום מחייבים ציון מפורש בתעודת הביטוח. הפוליסה רלוונטית לביטוח רכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון. מטרות שימוש מותרות כוללות מטרות חברתיות, פרטיות, עסקיות, מבחן נהיגה, הדרכת נהיגה, הובלת נוסעים בתשלום וגרירת רכב בתשלום.

sketch:
6. Permitted objectives of use
6.1 The insurer 's liability according to this policy shall apply only if at the time of the occurrence of the insured event the vehicle serves the insured for one or more of the following objectives:
6.1.1 Social, private or business objectives of the insured, which are not included in paragraphs 6.1.2 through 6.1.4 hereunder.
6.1.2 A business objective -a driving test on behalf of the licensing authority and a business objective of teaching driving, which is not an advanced practical driving lessons in accordance with Regulation 213a of the Transportation
Regulations, provided that these objectives are expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.3 A business objective of transporting passengers in the vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.4 A business objective of salvage or towing of a motorized vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.

טבלה: מטרות שימוש מותרות
This table details the permitted uses of a vehicle under a car insurance policy. It specifies which objectives of use are covered by the insurer's liability, and notes requirements for business-related uses.
ממדים: objective of use, insurer's liability condition

6. Permitted objectives of use
6.1 The insurer 's liability according to this policy shall apply only if at the time of the occurrence of the insured event the vehicle serves the insured for one or more of the following objectives:
6.1.1 Social, private or business objectives of the insured, which are not included in paragraphs 6.1.2 through 6.1.4 hereunder.
6.1.2 A business objective -a driving test on behalf of the licensing authority and a business objective of teaching driving, which is not an advanced practical driving lessons in accordance with Regulation 213a of the Transportation
Regulations, provided that these objectives are expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.3 A business objective of transporting passengers in the vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.4 A business objective of salvage or towing of a motorized vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
